title: MPC and flexible inflation targeting
quote: Target 4% CPI ±2%: set by the Centre with RBI (Sec 45ZA), achieved by the MPC (Sec 45ZB)

items.what: ==**RBI (Amendment) Act**==: Sec **45Z to 45ZO**; MPC first meets **October 2016**

boxes.title: Key sections
head: Section
Provision
rows: Centre, with RBI, sets target ==once every **five years**==
Failure: CPI **above 6% or below 2%** for ==three consecutive **quarters**==; RBI reports reasons, remedy, time

levels.name: Three external members
levels.note: Appointed by **Central Government**; **4-year** term; no reappointment

boxes.title: MPC procedure
items: Meets ==**at least 4 times a year**== (in practice six)
Quorum **4**, incl. Governor or Deputy Governor
Decides **policy repo rate**; binding on RBI

items.what: Unanimous hold, neutral; minutes hint at a hike

boxes.title: CPI anchor & debates
items: Debate: headline vs **core** targeting; food shocks outside MPC control

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: RBI Act amended for FIT in ==**2016**== (APPSC 2022)
Not an objective: govt revenue, stock market, fixing rupee-dollar rate
